title: Safety for Whom? Refusing the Right Subset of a Topic, Not the Whole Topic
authors: Antonio Tiene, Alejo López-Ávila, Iker García-Ferrero.
summary: We study how to train LLMs to refuse harmful requests within a topic while still answering legitimate ones. Self-generated training data and harmful-benign prompt pairs help control that boundary, and evaluating both sides reveals the trade-off between safety and over-refusal.

title: Quantization-Aware Healing: a compressed, 4-bit model that outperforms its full-precision original
authors: Antonio Tiene, Iker García-Ferrero, Ali Hashemi, Bakbergen Ryskulov.
summary: Recovering compressed, 4-bit LLMs by distilling directly from the original model. We examine accuracy, training stability, and the cost of recovery.

title: Making Knowledge Distillation Cheap Enough to Run at Scale
authors: Antonio Tiene, Iker García-Ferrero, Ali Hashemi, Bakbergen Ryskulov.
summary: How offline teacher logits and a fused KL loss make distillation more efficient in memory and compute, with benchmarks and an open-source implementation.

title: Releasing Open Weights for FLUX.1 Krea
authors: Sangwu Lee, Titus Ebbecke, Erwann Millon, Will Beddow, Le Zhuo, Iker García-Ferrero, Liam Esparraguera, Mihai Petrescu, Gian Saß, Gabriel Menezes, Victor Perez
summary: The training process behind FLUX.1 Krea, an open image-generation model developed with Black Forest Labs, with a focus on aesthetics and photorealism.

title: GoLLIE: Guideline-following Large Language Model for Information Extraction
authors: Oscar Sainz, Iker García-Ferrero, Rodrigo Agerri, Oier Lopez de Lacalle, German Rigau and Eneko Agirre
summary: We present GoLLIE, a Large Language Model trained to follow annotation guidelines. It outperforms previous approaches on zero-shot IE and supports schemas defined on the fly.

title: Did ChatGPT cheat on your test? (2023)
authors: Oscar Sainz, Jon Ander Campos, Iker García-Ferrero, Julen Etxaniz, Eneko Agirre
summary: We show popular benchmark datasets are already memorized by ChatGPT and that one can prompt ChatGPT to regenerate them.
